sections.title: About this guide
data: Newport has a Coast Guard small-boat station on Yaquina Bay, a smaller station at Depoe Bay to the north, and a helicopter air facility at the airport. The home counts come from the Coast Guard's housing map; the unit facts come from the Coast Guard Historian's Office and an undated Depoe Bay fact sheet.
WARNING on the air facility: a congressional letter of November 2025 says a helicopter was moved to North Bend and the facility's future was uncertain. Ask your sponsor what is current.
Ask your sponsor before you move.

sections.title: Coast Guard Housing
data: The Coast Guard's housing map lists 18 active homes at the Yaquina Bay housing site in Newport and 7 active homes at Depoe Bay.

In the Coast Guard, assignment to Coast Guard housing is generally mandatory when a home is available, and BAH starts only after the housing office releases you to rent in town. Ask your sponsor for the local housing officer before you look at rentals.
